STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_097786.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_097786.v · Open raw
module origen_097786 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [7:0] ASCII [31:0],
    output reg E,
    output reg RS,
    output wire RW,
    output reg [7:0] DB
);

    // State encoding
    localparam [2:0] 
        sSetup_start = 3'b000,
        sSetup_end   = 3'b001,
        sCursor_start = 3'b010,
        sCursor_end   = 3'b011,
        sChar        = 3'b100,
        sChar_end    = 3'b101;

    reg [2:0] state, next_state;

    reg [4:0] char;
    reg [2:0] setup;

    assign RW = 1'b0; // Always write mode

    // Sequential logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            state <= sSetup_start;
            char <= 5'd0;
            setup <= 3'd0;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
            if (state == sChar_end) begin
                if (char == 5'd31)
                    char <= 5'd0;
                else
                    char <= char + 1'b1;
            end
            if (state == sSetup_end) begin
                if (setup == 3'd3)
                    setup <= 3'd0;
                else
                    setup <= setup + 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    // Combinational logic
    always @(*) begin
        // Default values
        next_state = state;
        E = 1'b0;
        RS = 1'b0;
        DB = 8'h00;

        case (state)
            sSetup_start: begin
                case (setup)
                    3'd0: DB = 8'h38; // Function set
                    3'd1: DB = 8'h0C; // Display on, cursor on
                    3'd2: DB = 8'h06; // Entry mode set
                    3'd3: DB = 8'h01; // Clear display
                endcase
                next_state = sSetup_end;
            end

            sSetup_end: begin
                E = 1'b1;
                if (setup == 3'd3)
                    next_state = sCursor_start;
                else
                    next_state = sSetup_start;
            end

            sCursor_start: begin
                RS = 1'b0;
                DB = (char < 5'd16) ? {3'b100, char[4:0]} : {3'b110, char[4:0] - 5'd16};
                next_state = sCursor_end;
            end

            sCursor_end: begin
                E = 1'b1;
                next_state = sChar;
            end

            sChar: begin
                RS = 1'b1;
                DB = ASCII[char];
                next_state = sChar_end;
            end

            sChar_end: begin
                E = 1'b1;
                RS = 1'b1;
                if (char == 5'd31)
                    next_state = sSetup_start;
                else
                    next_state = sCursor_start;
            end

            default: next_state = sSetup_start;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
